role: incidence lower bound (Furstenberg/Kakeya analogue) forcing a certificate in the (C, prime) incidence structure
missing_theorem: At fixed p, the incidences between residue lines {C ≡ −(4p)^{−1} (mod q)} and the divisibility conditions force some C with a divisor of 4Cp + 1 ≡ −1 (mod 4C). Lines for q larger than the level range meet at most one C (privacy of large primes), so the incidence structure among them is trivial. The non-trivial incidences involve only small q, i.e. congruence (B1) data.
